'''Tk-216''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|The...things. The virus changed everyone when it was released. All my friends...they change. They chased me.|Tk-216, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:ID" />}}
Tk-216 was a stormtrooper of the Galactic Empire from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gala]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he was stationed near an [[Imperial Research and Prison Facility]] on the remote planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. There, the Empire was conducting secret and dangerous scientific research, intending to engineer the dreadful [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A|Blackwing virus]] in order to create super soldiers.<ref name="SWG:ID" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> an accident happened at the Imperial Research Facility and resulted in the virus [[Blackwing virus outbreak on Dathomir|outbreak]]. Most of the Imperial staff was killed and became flesh-craving [[Zombie/Legends|undead]] creatures. Luckily, Tk-216 survived the attack of the creatures and finally managed to escape the area, avoiding containment into the promptly-established [[Quarantine Zone (Dathomir)|Quarantine Zone]]. Tk-216 and other people, such as [[Illrian Nhagy]] and [[Tyla Gallamby]], were still present near the Quarantine Zone, awaiting evaluation out of the planet, when independent spacers started to arrive on Dathomir to investigate the outbreak.<ref name="SWG:ID" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tk-216 appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] (NPC) in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:ID" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Tk-216 was added to the game with the "[[W:c:swg:Game Update 13|Game Update 13]]," released on [[September 30]], [[2009]].<ref>{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1003113|text=''Star Wars'' Galaxies: Game Update 13 -- Chronicle Master System}}</ref> This NPC was part of the questline "[[W:c:swg:Something is Obviously Wrong|Something is Obviously Wrong]],"<ref name="SWG:ID" /> an introduction to the "[[W:c:swg:Death Troopers|Death Troopers]]" [[W:c:swg:Game Update 14|update]].<ref name="SonyForumsCite-Game Update 14: Death Troopers">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/posts/list.m?topic_id=1008376|text=Game Update 14: Death Troopers}}</ref>

Unlike most other stormtroopers in the game, Tk-216 is identified with a lower case "k." It is not clear if this was deliberate, or an error on the part of the developers.<ref name="SWG:ID" />
